name: Mikado
source:
A monk of the "Goddess Church". He has a good, kind personality and is easily swayed around.

Kyosuke and Jean are both his childhood friends. He secretly has feelings for Susie, the only daughter of the inn's manager.

"Oh, I am! I am!"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
